name: Self-Employment Tax Calculator
meta_description: Estimate your 2026 self-employment tax: 12.4% Social Security up to the wage base, 2.9% Medicare, the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax and your deductible half.
subtitle: Work out the 2026 Social Security and Medicare tax on your freelance or business profit, the half you can deduct, and how much to set aside each quarter.

$

Box 5 of your W-2s. Leave blank to use the Social Security wages figure.
